titre: La demande de crédit bancaire accélère aux États-Unis
sous_titre: Croissance des encours de prêts sur un an, ensemble des banques américaines assurées, en %, du 3e trimestre 2025 au 2e trimestre 2026

series.nom: Croissance des prêts sur un an

2025 T3.texte: The industry's annual rate of loan growth in the third quarter was 4.7 percent, below the pre-pandemic average of 4.9 percent.

2025 T4.texte: Loan growth accelerated to 2.0 percent from the prior quarter, and annual growth increased to 5.9 percent.

2026 T1.texte: Loan growth increased 1.6 percent from the prior quarter, and annual growth accelerated to 7.1 percent.

2026 T2.texte: Loan growth was widespread, increasing 1.8 percent from the prior quarter and 6.8 percent from the prior year.
